result: Configured browser surface preserved across DPR and CSS resize; physical iPhone page-crash cause and a separate desktop WebKit forced pause remain open.
artifact_convention: Paths are logical names within the retained mobile-crash-followup-20261003 evidence bundle; recordings, disc inputs and machine paths are not published.

user_observation.facts: Original CSS is visible at 23.8 seconds; Chrome shows Cannot open this page at 23.9 seconds. No Start/SSS transition is visible. The recording starts with Resume visible, but its pause reason is unavailable.
user_observation.limits: No incident-specific current-release backend report, OS termination reason, device model or iOS version is available. The staging byte verification does not prove the recording loaded those exact bytes.

owner.defect: Aurora enabled SDL high pixel density and resizable browser surfaces. Pinned SDL multiplied configured 640x480 by DPR and subsequently resized to CSS dimensions times DPR.
owner.fix: Only Emscripten omits high-density/resizable flags and explicitly checks SDL_SetWindowSize to the configured dimensions before GPU setup. CSS retains presentation scaling; generic startFullscreen and native flags are preserved.
preserved: Input coordinates, source draw order, float arithmetic and RNG
GPU stream buffer limits and acquired-surface viewport/scissor bounds
owner.reuse: Uses the existing configured game dimensions and SDL size API. Retains the prior acquired-surface guard; no user-agent exceptions, guessed memory caps or texture-content changes.

startup_resize.scope: Graphics preparation plus Controls open; fixed backing pixels across real CSS resize.

presentation.scope: Aspect, nonempty game pixels, touch alignment, toolbar clearance, pointer mapping and DOM fullscreen; OS fullscreen/physical input unrun.

touch_css.scope: 30 seconds of actual CDP touch input in original CSS, DPR3 390x844. No Start, SSS or Resume. Headless installed Chrome on macOS; not physical iOS.
touch_css.texture_measurement_limit: Cumulative requested API allocations with known formats; unknown formats excluded. Not resident/live/peak GPU memory. One bounded run per package; driver cache uncontrolled.
touch_css.source_audio: Nonzero original PCM and AudioWorklet processing remained enabled; downstream speaker output muted.

public_route.scope: Actual HTTP inventory/bytes/headers and original CSS to SSS to short Mario/Final Destination to No Contest Results to CSS, warm menu round trip and Eject. Nonzero PCM at boundaries; no observed JS errors or unexpected pause. Not a natural four-stock or whole-session acceptance run.

retained_failures.boundary: Baseline surface changes to 363x272 at DPR1 landscape instead of configured pixels.
First packaging correctly refused a stale native producer identity; rebuilt before preparing a fresh immutable package.
Early disc selection in desktop WebKit remained in preparation until the bounded deadline; no page crash.
Startup-only WebKit reducer reached readiness without GPU errors.
Ready-gated desktop WebKit CSS produced a forced timing pause on both baseline and the initial fixed-surface candidate. No raw incident owner was captured in these reports.

open_gates: Physical iPhone crash reproduction and termination reason
Desktop WebKit simulation-backlog stall cause, including observer-effect separation
Sustained natural session on this surface patch
Original pixels/PCM comparison, uninterrupted audio, physical controller and foreground/mobile performance
deployment: No merge or deployment included; staging retest requires explicit authorization.
resource_handoff: Owned browser/HTTP jobs closed. Retained recordings, failed reducers and small receipts preserved; incremental builds retained for active mobile follow-up.

webkit_first_incident_reducer.scope: Desktop engine diagnostic only; does not identify the physical iPhone termination.
webkit_first_incident_reducer.classification_limit: Runner incorrectly baselined away the already-captured incident at the CSS gate, then labeled pause_without_incident. The raw incident is retained in css_gate_hook and hook_at_stop. No rerun was used to reconstruct it.
webkit_first_incident_reducer.attribution_limit: Native timing-detail rows are unavailable in this public package. Callback-gap cause, including observation overhead, remains unclassified; this is not physical iPhone crash attribution.

test_host.audio: PCM and AudioWorklet enabled, downstream speaker sink silent
test_host.timing_limit: Functional/resource measurements only; not foreground or mobile performance admission.
